end_to_end_recent_only.purpose: Baseline for what an explicitly seeded recent context can solve.

end_to_end_recent_plus_ltm.purpose: Full-system memory condition with the same recent seed as the recent-only baseline.

evaluation_modes.ltm_uplift_definition: Compare recent+LTM against recent-only using the exact same recent seed.

recent_context_caveat.note: D19–D21 become recent context only when the run explicitly seeds them. Prior synthetic sessions are never treated as recent by default across session boundaries.

qa_execution_context_contract.recent_plus_ltm_rule: Use exactly the same explicit recent seed as recent_only, then add LTM. The only intended difference between these two E2E modes is the presence of LTM.
